atoms.text: Dusty also wants to show you around some factories.

instruction.text: Answer Dusty’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>What is a factory?</voice>

b.sound: A place where people use machines to make things, such as food, toys or cars!
A place where you can go swimming with friends.

instruction.text: Select the three images of factory equipment.

feedback.finish: Factories use machines to make things. They are much quicker than humans, but humans still need to work the machines and make sure everything is in order!
feedback.wrong: Watering cans are not used in factories.

instruction.text: This is a machine at a toy factory. Select the pink toy to learn more.

feedback.end: Machines can make lots of the same toy by creating all the pieces and putting them together very neatly! This is how so many toys can be quickly made and sold.

instruction.text: This is a machine at a dairy factory. Select one of the yoghurt pots to learn more.

feedback.end: This machine puts yoghurt into pots. It can quickly fill up hundreds of pots with exactly the same amount of yoghurt!

instruction.text: This is a conveyor belt. Select one of the bottles to learn more.

feedback.end: This conveyor belt moves bottles around the factory. It takes them through machines that package and label them.

feedback.correct: Correct! Although factories are important for making lots of useful things, they release a lot of smoke into the air. This is harmful for the environment.

atoms.a: “What do factories release that’s bad for the air?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>What do factories release that’s bad for the air?</voice>

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Dusty wants to learn more about factories by talking with workers here. Listen to the options and select the questions he could ask.

atoms.a: “I want to learn more about these machines. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>I want to learn more about these machines. What should I ask?</voice>

b.sound: Do you know how these machines work?
When do you usually have lunch?

atoms.a: “I want to learn about what it’s like to work here. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>I want to learn about what it’s like to work here. What should I ask?</voice>

b.sound: Can you describe your usual working day?
What is your favourite dog breed?
